requirements.label: Undergraduate degree · Cambridge school qualification
requirements.details: The general degree route requires an O-level or School Certificate English Language pass or equivalent. The HSC or GCE route requires at least three SC/O-level credits and two A-level passes. An AS or subsidiary General Paper pass may be accepted as English evidence.

requirements.label: Programme · subject eligibility
requirements.details: Earn one School Certificate credit in a science and pass at least two approved related sciences at A level. The A-level list includes Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Food Studies, Botany, Zoology, Environmental Studies and Computer Science. Applicants missing School Certificate credit in Mathematics, Chemistry or Biology must take the applicable foundation module in year one. An approved equivalent route remains subject to degree-level and programme requirements.

source.title: University of Mauritius 2026/2027 · Programme · subject eligibility

requirements.label: Programme · subject eligibility
requirements.details: Earn O-level credits in Mathematics and Chemistry and pass two related approved A levels. Listed examples include Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Food Studies, Botany, Zoology, Marine Biology, Computer Science and Computing.

source.title: University of Mauritius 2026/2027 · Programme · subject eligibility

requirements.label: Programme · subject eligibility

profiles.notes: The dedicated international regulations describe overseas school qualification and document pathways.

requirements.label: International degree · HSC and London GCE routes
requirements.details: Chapter 14 lists HSC routes of two A-level and two AS/subsidiary passes with O-level credits, or three A-level and one AS/subsidiary pass. The London GCE route lists three A-level passes. An SC/O-level English pass or equivalent is required. For the first HSC route, three other O-level credits are needed, reduced to two if English is a credit.

source.title: University of Mauritius 2026/2027 · International degree · HSC and London GCE routes

requirements.label: International degree · equivalence and English evidence
requirements.details: Overseas school-leaving qualifications require Senate recognition. For applicants without recognised English evidence, the regulations name IELTS, TOEFL or similar tests. Applicants from twelve-year schooling systems may need SAT. The general policy supplies no numeric test cutoff for these alternatives.

source.title: University of Mauritius 2026/2027 · International degree · equivalence and English evidence

requirements.label: International degree · application evidence
requirements.details: Use the university’s international application form and submit the requested documents before the stated deadline. The regulations call for the application number, evidence of fee payment and copies of birth, educational and relevant professional certificates.
